orgs.name: Google DeepMind
orgs.description: Google's AI lab and the single largest source of landmarks in this gallery: the Genie world models (Genie 1 to 3), the Veo video models with native audio, CAT3D and the SIMA game agents.
orgs.description_zh: Google 的人工智能实验室，也是本图库中里程碑作品最多的来源：Genie 世界模型（Genie 1 至 3）、能原生生成声音的 Veo 视频模型、CAT3D 以及 SIMA 游戏智能体。

orgs.name: OpenAI
orgs.description: Released Sora (2024), which framed video models as world simulators, and Sora 2 with synchronized sound (2025), plus the gpt-realtime speech-to-speech API. It closed the Sora app in April 2026 and the Sora API in September 2026, moving the team to world simulation research.
orgs.description_zh: 推出了 Sora（2024，把视频模型定位为“世界模拟器”）和能同步生成声音的 Sora 2（2025），以及 gpt-realtime 语音到语音 API。2026 年 4 月关闭 Sora 应用、9 月关闭 Sora API，团队转向世界模拟研究。

orgs.name: Meta Reality Labs Research
orgs.description: Meta's research arm for AR and VR, home of Codec Avatars (photoreal telepresence), Hyperscape room capture with Gaussian splatting, and the Aria research glasses.
orgs.description_zh: Meta 的 AR / VR 研究部门，Codec Avatars（照片级远程临场化身）、基于高斯泼溅的 Hyperscape 房间捕捉以及 Aria 科研眼镜都出自这里。
orgs.based_zh: 美国雷德蒙德 / 匹兹堡

orgs.name: AI at Meta (FAIR & Superintelligence Labs)
orgs.description: Meta's AI research groups, which released V-JEPA 2 world models, the Seamless Interaction dataset and models of two-person face-to-face behavior, and SAM 3D; the research page now leads with its 2026 Muse models.
orgs.description_zh: Meta 的人工智能研究部门，发布了 V-JEPA 2 世界模型、刻画双人面对面行为的 Seamless Interaction 数据集与模型，以及 SAM 3D；其研究主页现以 2026 年的 Muse 系列模型为首。

orgs.name: NVIDIA Spatial Intelligence Lab
orgs.description: NVIDIA's research lab for AI that perceives, models and interacts with the physical world (the former Toronto AI Lab), behind 3D-consistent video and world generation such as GEN3C and Lyra and the 3DGUT renderer.
orgs.description_zh: NVIDIA 研究感知、建模并与物理世界交互的 AI 的实验室（原多伦多 AI 实验室），推出了 GEN3C、Lyra 等三维一致的视频与世界生成方法，以及 3DGUT 渲染器。

orgs.name: Microsoft Research
orgs.description: Microsoft's research organization, which produced VASA-1 lifelike talking faces from one photo, the Muse (WHAM) game world model with Xbox, and the open Rocketbox avatar library used across VR studies.
orgs.description_zh: 微软的研究机构，推出了由一张照片生成逼真说话人脸的 VASA-1、与 Xbox 合作的 Muse（WHAM）游戏世界模型，以及被大量 VR 研究使用的开源 Rocketbox 虚拟人库。

orgs.name: World Labs
orgs.description: The spatial-intelligence company founded by Fei-Fei Li, Justin Johnson, Ben Mildenhall and Christoph Lassner; its Marble product generates persistent, editable 3D worlds from text, images, video and 3D layouts.
orgs.description_zh: 由李飞飞、Justin Johnson、Ben Mildenhall 与 Christoph Lassner 创立的空间智能公司；其产品 Marble 能由文字、图像、视频和三维布局生成持久、可编辑的三维世界。

orgs.name: Runway
orgs.description: New York company that turned video generation into filmmaking tools (Gen-1 through Gen-4.5, Act-Two, Aleph) and in December 2025 launched GWM-1, a general world model; it also runs the AI Festival (AIF).
orgs.description_zh: 纽约公司，把视频生成变成电影制作工具（Gen-1 至 Gen-4.5、Act-Two、Aleph），并于 2025 年 12 月推出通用世界模型 GWM-1；它还主办 AI 电影节（AIF）。

orgs.name: Luma AI
orgs.description: Started with NeRF and splat capture on phones, then released the Dream Machine and Ray video models; its site now presents AI agents for creative work.
orgs.description_zh: 从手机上的 NeRF 与高斯泼溅捕捉起步，之后发布 Dream Machine 与 Ray 系列视频模型；其网站现在主推面向创意工作的 AI 智能体。

orgs.name: Decart
orgs.description: Real-time generative video lab: Oasis (2024) was a playable world model of a Minecraft-like game, and MirageLSD (2025) restyles live camera video in real time.
orgs.description_zh: 实时生成视频实验室：Oasis（2024）是一款类 Minecraft 游戏的可玩世界模型，MirageLSD（2025）能对实时摄像头画面进行实时风格转换。
orgs.based: San Francisco, US / Tel Aviv, IL
orgs.based_zh: 美国旧金山 / 以色列特拉维夫

orgs.name: General Intuition
orgs.description: World-model lab co-founded by DIAMOND author Eloi Alonso that trains agents and world models on large archives of game play, describing itself as 'the frontier lab for acting in space and time'.
orgs.description_zh: 由 DIAMOND 作者 Eloi Alonso 联合创立的世界模型实验室，利用大量游戏录像训练智能体与世界模型，自称“在空间与时间中行动的前沿实验室”。

orgs.name: Simile
orgs.description: Palo Alto company founded by generative-agents author Joon Sung Park that sells simulations of how customers, employees or populations respond to change; it announced a $200M Series B at a $2B valuation in 2026.
orgs.description_zh: 由“生成式智能体”作者 Joon Sung Park 创立的帕洛阿尔托公司，提供关于顾客、员工或人群如何回应变化的模拟服务；2026 年宣布完成 2 亿美元 B 轮融资，估值 20 亿美元。

orgs.name: ElevenLabs
orgs.description: Voice AI company whose text-to-speech, voice cloning, sound effects, music and conversational agent platform supply the voices of many generated characters and virtual humans.
orgs.description_zh: 语音 AI 公司，其文本转语音、声音克隆、音效、音乐与对话智能体平台，为许多生成角色与虚拟人提供声音。
orgs.based_zh: 英国伦敦 / 美国纽约

orgs.name: Kyutai
orgs.description: Non-profit open-science AI lab in Paris that released Moshi, the first open full-duplex speech model, plus Hibiki live speech translation and the Unmute voice stack; its voice work was spun out as Gradium in 2025.
orgs.description_zh: 巴黎的非营利开放科学 AI 实验室，发布了首个开源全双工语音模型 Moshi，以及实时语音翻译 Hibiki 与语音系统 Unmute；其语音技术于 2025 年分拆为 Gradium 公司。

orgs.name: Gradium
orgs.description: Paris voice-AI company spun out of Kyutai in December 2025 and led by Neil Zeghidour; it turns the Moshi line of research into a real-time voice API for agents (low-latency speech synthesis, transcription, live translation and voice cloning).
orgs.description_zh: 2025 年 12 月从 Kyutai 分拆出的巴黎语音 AI 公司，由 Neil Zeghidour 领导；它把 Moshi 一脉的研究转化为面向智能体的实时语音 API（低延迟语音合成、转写、实时翻译与声音克隆）。

orgs.name: Tencent Hunyuan
orgs.description: Tencent's foundation-model team, one of the most prolific open-weight sources in the field: HunyuanVideo, Hunyuan3D, HunyuanWorld and the GameCraft game-video model.
orgs.description_zh: 腾讯的基础模型团队，是该领域最活跃的开源权重来源之一：HunyuanVideo、Hunyuan3D、HunyuanWorld 以及游戏视频模型 GameCraft。

orgs.name: ByteDance Seed
orgs.description: ByteDance's foundation-model team, formed in 2023, behind the Seedance video models, OmniHuman audio-driven human animation and Seed3D.
orgs.description_zh: 字节跳动 2023 年成立的基础模型团队，推出了 Seedance 视频模型、音频驱动人体动画 OmniHuman 以及 Seed3D。

orgs.name: Kling AI (Kuaishou)
orgs.description: Kuaishou's video-generation product, launched in June 2024 and updated through a fast series of Kling versions that have often ranked at or near the top of public video arenas.
orgs.description_zh: 快手的视频生成产品，于 2024 年 6 月上线，此后快速迭代多个可灵版本，多次位居公开视频竞技场榜首或前列。

orgs.name: Alibaba Tongyi Wan
orgs.description: Alibaba's Tongyi Lab video family; Wan 2.1 and 2.2 were released as open weights and became a common base for open video research and fine-tunes.
orgs.description_zh: 阿里巴巴通义实验室的视频模型系列；Wan 2.1 与 2.2 以开源权重发布，成为开源视频研究与微调的常用底座。

orgs.name: Shanghai AI Laboratory
orgs.description: State-backed research institute founded in 2020 that publishes open models and benchmarks, including the Vchitect video-generation project behind the VBench leaderboard (with NTU S-Lab).
orgs.description_zh: 2020 年成立的国家支持的研究机构，发布开源模型与评测基准，包括与南洋理工 S-Lab 合作、支撑 VBench 排行榜的 Vchitect 视频生成项目。

orgs.name: MiniMax
orgs.description: Shanghai AI company whose Hailuo video models and Speech text-to-speech models have ranked near the top of public video and speech arenas.
orgs.description_zh: 上海人工智能公司，旗下海螺（Hailuo）视频模型与 Speech 语音合成模型在公开视频与语音竞技场中名列前茅。

orgs.name: Shengshu Technology (Vidu)
orgs.description: Beijing company spun out of Tsinghua University, maker of the Vidu video models (first released April 2024) with reference-to-video for consistent characters.
orgs.description_zh: 源自清华大学的北京公司，推出 Vidu 视频模型（2024 年 4 月首发），以“参考生视频”保持角色一致性见长。

orgs.name: Hume AI
orgs.description: Voice AI company grounded in emotion science, maker of the EVI empathic voice interface and Octave TTS; it now also sells expression measurement (600+ dimensions) for evaluating voice agents, which is useful for coding affect in studies.
orgs.description_zh: 以情绪科学为基础的语音 AI 公司，推出共情语音接口 EVI 与 Octave 语音合成；现在也提供 600 多个维度的表情测量，用于评估语音智能体，也可用于研究中的情感编码。

orgs.name: Mursion
orgs.description: Immersive simulation company where employees practice difficult conversations with avatars that push back; it began with human simulation specialists voicing the avatars and now markets an AI-powered upskilling platform.
orgs.description_zh: 沉浸式模拟公司，员工可以与会“顶嘴”的虚拟人练习棘手对话；它起初由真人模拟专家为虚拟人配音和操控，如今主推 AI 驱动的技能提升平台。

orgs.name: Event Lab (Universitat de Barcelona)
orgs.description: Mel Slater's Barcelona lab for virtual environments in neuroscience and technology, known for studies of body ownership, embodiment and people's responses to virtual others.
orgs.description_zh: Mel Slater 在巴塞罗那领导的“神经科学与技术中的虚拟环境”实验室，以身体拥有感、具身以及人们对虚拟他人反应的研究著称。

orgs.name: UCL Virtual Environments and Computer Graphics (VECG)
orgs.description: UCL Computer Science group where much of presence research took shape in the 1990s–2000s, including Slater's virtual Milgram (2006) and Arsenal-fan bystander (2013) studies; it continues to work on VR, collaborative virtual environments and graphics.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦大学学院计算机系研究组，临场感研究在 1990–2000 年代的大量奠基工作在此完成，包括 Slater 的虚拟米尔格拉姆实验（2006）与以阿森纳球迷为对象的旁观者研究（2013）；至今仍研究 VR、协同虚拟环境与图形学。

orgs.name: Stanford Virtual Human Interaction Lab (VHIL)
orgs.description: Jeremy Bailenson's lab studying what VR and avatars do to people, from the Proteus effect to Zoom fatigue and large-scale VR classes.
orgs.description_zh: Jeremy Bailenson 的实验室，研究 VR 与化身会对人产生什么影响，从普罗透斯效应到“Zoom 疲劳”与大规模 VR 课程。

orgs.name: USC Institute for Creative Technologies
orgs.description: Army-sponsored USC research center that has built interactive virtual humans for training and therapy for two decades, including Bravemind VR exposure therapy and the SimSensei virtual interviewer.
orgs.description_zh: 由美国陆军资助的南加州大学研究中心，二十多年来为训练与治疗构建交互式虚拟人，包括 Bravemind VR 暴露疗法与 SimSensei 虚拟访谈者。

orgs.name: Max Planck Institute for the Study of Crime, Security and Law
orgs.name_zh: 马克斯·普朗克犯罪、安全与法律研究所
orgs.description: Freiburg institute whose criminology department, led by Jean-Louis van Gelder, uses virtual reality to study offending, victimization and decision-making under realistic conditions.
orgs.description_zh: 位于弗莱堡的研究所，其犯罪学部门由 Jean-Louis van Gelder 领导，用虚拟现实在接近真实的条件下研究犯罪、受害与决策。

orgs.name: Inria GraphDeco
orgs.description: George Drettakis's graphics group at Inria Sophia Antipolis, where 3D Gaussian Splatting was invented (SIGGRAPH 2023 best paper) and released with open code.
orgs.description_zh: George Drettakis 在 Inria 索菲亚-安提波利斯中心的图形学研究组，3D 高斯泼溅在此诞生（SIGGRAPH 2023 最佳论文）并开源发布。
orgs.based_zh: 法国索菲亚-安提波利斯

orgs.name: Stanford Vision and Learning Lab (SVL)
orgs.description: Stanford lab of Fei-Fei Li, Jiajun Wu and colleagues that builds simulation environments and benchmarks for embodied agents (BEHAVIOR, OmniGibson) and evaluations of world generation such as WorldScore.
orgs.description_zh: 斯坦福大学由李飞飞、吴佳俊等人组成的实验室，构建具身智能体的模拟环境与基准（BEHAVIOR、OmniGibson），以及 WorldScore 等世界生成评测。

orgs.name: MMLab@NTU / S-Lab
orgs.description: Nanyang Technological University's multimedia lab (Chen Change Loy, Ziwei Liu), a major source of open video, 3D and avatar generators and of the VBench benchmark.
orgs.description_zh: 南洋理工大学多媒体实验室（吕健勤、刘子纬），大量开源视频、三维与虚拟人生成模型以及 VBench 评测基准的来源。

orgs.name: Reality Design Lab
orgs.description: Botao 'Amber' Hu's design research lab working on mixed reality and generative immersive experiences, maker of the open HoloKit toolkit; it makes this gallery, Generative Reality Inspire.
orgs.description_zh: 胡博涛（Botao “Amber” Hu）的设计研究实验室，研究混合现实与生成式沉浸体验，开发开源 HoloKit 工具包；本图库 Generative Reality Inspire 即由其制作。

orgs.name: ACM SIGGRAPH & SIGGRAPH Asia
orgs.description: The main computer graphics conferences, where NeRF-era rendering, 3D Gaussian Splatting, avatar and motion-generation papers appear, along with an Immersive Pavilion and Real-Time Live demos.
orgs.description_zh: 最重要的计算机图形学会议，NeRF 时代的渲染、3D 高斯泼溅、虚拟人与动作生成论文在此发表，并设有沉浸式展区与 Real-Time Live 实时演示。

orgs.name: CVPR
orgs.description: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition, the largest vision venue and the usual home of video generation, 3D/4D reconstruction and world-generation papers and workshops.
orgs.description_zh: IEEE/CVF 计算机视觉与模式识别会议，规模最大的视觉会议，视频生成、三维 / 四维重建与世界生成论文和研讨会的主要阵地。

orgs.name: ICCV & ECCV
orgs.description: The International and European Conferences on Computer Vision, held in alternate years (ICCV odd, ECCV even); NeRF appeared at ECCV 2020 and DiT at ICCV 2023.
orgs.description_zh: 国际计算机视觉大会与欧洲计算机视觉会议，隔年交替举办（ICCV 奇数年，ECCV 偶数年）；NeRF 发表于 ECCV 2020，DiT 发表于 ICCV 2023。

orgs.name: NeurIPS
orgs.description: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems, where much world-model, diffusion and agent research is published, along with datasets and benchmarks tracks.
orgs.description_zh: 神经信息处理系统大会，大量世界模型、扩散模型与智能体研究在此发表，并设有数据集与基准赛道。

orgs.name: ICLR
orgs.description: International Conference on Learning Representations, with open review on OpenReview; GameNGen and many video and world-model papers appeared here.
orgs.description_zh: 国际学习表征会议，采用 OpenReview 公开评审；GameNGen 以及许多视频与世界模型论文发表于此。

orgs.name: ACM CHI
orgs.description: The ACM Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems, the largest HCI venue, where generative XR systems, LLM agent studies and VR user studies are published.
orgs.description_zh: ACM 人机交互大会，规模最大的人机交互会议，生成式 XR 系统、大模型智能体研究与 VR 用户研究在此发表。

orgs.name: ACM UIST
orgs.description: ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology, where Generative Agents won a best paper in 2023 and many AR authoring and AI-in-the-loop systems debut.
orgs.description_zh: ACM 用户界面软件与技术研讨会，《Generative Agents》于 2023 年在此获最佳论文，许多 AR 创作与人机协同 AI 系统在此首次发表。

orgs.name: IEEE VR
orgs.description: IEEE Conference on Virtual Reality and 3D User Interfaces, the main venue for VR systems, presence and embodiment studies; its papers are published in IEEE TVCG.
orgs.description_zh: IEEE 虚拟现实与三维用户界面会议，VR 系统、临场感与具身研究的主要会议；其论文发表于 IEEE TVCG。

orgs.name: IEEE ISMAR
orgs.description: IEEE International Symposium on Mixed and Augmented Reality, the main AR/MR research venue, increasingly with generative and LLM-driven XR papers.
orgs.description_zh: IEEE 混合与增强现实国际研讨会，AR / MR 研究的主要会议，生成式与大模型驱动的 XR 论文日益增多。

orgs.name: ACM IVA (Intelligent Virtual Agents)
orgs.description: ACM conference on intelligent virtual agents: embodied conversational characters, nonverbal behavior generation and their use in training, health and research.
orgs.description_zh: ACM 智能虚拟智能体会议：关注具身对话角色、非语言行为生成，以及它们在训练、健康与研究中的应用。

orgs.name: I/ITSEC
orgs.description: The Interservice/Industry Training, Simulation and Education Conference in Orlando, the largest venue for military and industrial simulation training, where ICT's virtual-human trainers were presented.
orgs.description_zh: 奥兰多举办的跨军种 / 产业训练、模拟与教育会议，军事与工业模拟训练领域规模最大的会议，ICT 的虚拟人训练系统曾在此发表。

orgs.name: Venice Immersive
orgs.description: The immersive section of the Venice International Film Festival, the leading showcase and competition for VR, MR and immersive works since 2017.
orgs.description_zh: 威尼斯国际电影节的沉浸式单元，自 2017 年起是 VR、MR 与沉浸式作品最重要的展映与竞赛平台。

orgs.name: AIF (Runway AI Festival)
orgs.description: Runway's annual festival, started in 2023 as the AI Film Festival, that screens short films made with generative video tools.
orgs.description_zh: Runway 主办的年度节展，2023 年以“AI 电影节”名义创办，放映使用生成式视频工具制作的短片。

orgs.name: PRESENCE: Virtual and Augmented Reality
orgs.description: MIT Press journal founded in 1992 as Presence: Teleoperators and Virtual Environments, where presence theory, immersive journalism and much early VR behavior research were published.
orgs.description_zh: 麻省理工学院出版社期刊，1992 年以 Presence: Teleoperators and Virtual Environments 之名创刊，临场感理论、沉浸式新闻与大量早期 VR 行为研究在此发表。

orgs.name: Computers in Human Behavior
orgs.description: Elsevier journal on the psychology of computer use, a frequent outlet for studies of virtual humans, avatars and VR effects on behavior.
orgs.description_zh: 爱思唯尔出版的计算机使用心理学期刊，常发表关于虚拟人、化身以及 VR 对行为影响的研究。

orgs.name: Frontiers in Virtual Reality
orgs.description: Open-access journal founded in 2020 covering VR/AR technology and its use in psychology, health and training.
orgs.description_zh: 2020 年创刊的开放获取期刊，涵盖 VR / AR 技术及其在心理学、健康与训练中的应用。

orgs.name: IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics (TVCG)
orgs.description: IEEE journal that publishes the IEEE VR and ISMAR journal papers, the main archival outlet for VR systems and perception research.
orgs.description_zh: IEEE 期刊，刊载 IEEE VR 与 ISMAR 的期刊论文，是 VR 系统与感知研究的主要存档渠道。

orgs.name: ACM Transactions on Graphics (TOG)
orgs.description: The leading graphics journal, which publishes SIGGRAPH and SIGGRAPH Asia technical papers, among them 3D Gaussian Splatting and instant-ngp.
orgs.description_zh: 最重要的图形学期刊，刊载 SIGGRAPH 与 SIGGRAPH Asia 的技术论文，包括 3D 高斯泼溅与 instant-ngp。

orgs.name: Two Minute Papers
orgs.description: Károly Zsolnai-Fehér's YouTube channel that explains new graphics and AI papers in short videos; a quick way to see new video, splatting and simulation results in motion.
orgs.description_zh: Károly Zsolnai-Fehér 的 YouTube 频道，用短视频讲解图形学与 AI 新论文；快速看到视频生成、高斯泼溅与模拟新成果实际运行效果的途径。

orgs.name: Radiance Fields
orgs.description: News site and newsletter dedicated to radiance fields: Gaussian splatting, NeRF and the capture tools and platforms built on them.
orgs.description_zh: 专注辐射场的新闻网站与通讯：高斯泼溅、NeRF，以及基于它们的捕捉工具与平台。

orgs.name: Bilawal Sidhu
orgs.description: Creator and former Google Maps / AR product manager whose YouTube and social channels demo and explain 3D capture, splatting and generative video.
orgs.description_zh: 内容创作者，曾任 Google 地图 / AR 产品经理；其 YouTube 与社交账号演示并讲解三维捕捉、高斯泼溅与生成视频。

orgs.name: 80 Level
orgs.description: Industry site for game and 3D artists that tracks generative 3D, splatting and real-time tools as they enter production.
orgs.description_zh: 面向游戏与三维美术从业者的行业网站，追踪生成式三维、高斯泼溅与实时工具进入生产流程的进展。

orgs.name: Road to VR
orgs.description: Long-running XR news site covering headsets, platforms and immersive software, including generative features on Quest, Vision Pro and Android XR.
orgs.description_zh: 老牌 XR 新闻网站，报道头显、平台与沉浸式软件，包括 Quest、Vision Pro 与 Android XR 上的生成式功能。

orgs.name: UploadVR
orgs.description: XR news site that reports on VR and AR hardware, apps and platform changes, often with hands-on tests of new immersive features.
orgs.description_zh: XR 新闻网站，报道 VR 与 AR 硬件、应用与平台变化，常对新的沉浸式功能进行上手测试。

orgs.name: Voices of VR Podcast
orgs.description: Kent Bye's podcast, an oral history of XR with more than a thousand episodes of interviews with immersive artists, researchers and developers, including on XR ethics and AI.
orgs.description_zh: Kent Bye 主持的播客，以一千多期访谈记录 XR 的口述历史，受访者包括沉浸式艺术家、研究者与开发者，也涉及 XR 伦理与 AI。

orgs.name: Hugging Face Daily Papers
orgs.description: Daily, upvoted feed of new arXiv papers on Hugging Face, started by AK (@_akhaliq), with linked models, datasets and demo Spaces; the fastest way to catch new generative video, 3D and world-model releases.
orgs.description_zh: Hugging Face 上每日更新、按投票排序的 arXiv 新论文列表，由 AK（@_akhaliq）发起，并关联模型、数据集与演示 Space；追踪生成视频、三维与世界模型新发布最快的途径。

orgs.name: Hugging Face Spaces
orgs.description: Hosted demos for open models, where many video, 3D, avatar and speech models can be tried in the browser on release day.
orgs.description_zh: 开源模型的在线演示平台，许多视频、三维、虚拟人与语音模型在发布当天即可在浏览器中试用。

orgs.name: Awesome 3D Gaussian Splatting
orgs.description: MrNeRF's curated, regularly updated list of Gaussian splatting papers, code and tools, sorted by topic from compression to avatars and 4D.
orgs.description_zh: MrNeRF 维护、持续更新的高斯泼溅论文、代码与工具清单，按主题分类，从压缩到虚拟人与 4D。

orgs.name: Awesome World Models
orgs.description: Curated GitHub list of world-model papers across games, embodied AI, autonomous driving and video generation.
orgs.description_zh: GitHub 上的世界模型论文精选清单，涵盖游戏、具身智能、自动驾驶与视频生成。

orgs.name: Awesome Video Diffusion
orgs.description: Show Lab (NUS)'s curated list of video diffusion papers and code, from text-to-video to editing, control and long video.
orgs.description_zh: 新加坡国立大学 Show Lab 维护的视频扩散论文与代码清单，从文生视频到编辑、控制与长视频。

orgs.name: Awesome Talking Head Generation
orgs.description: Curated GitHub list of talking-head and audio-driven portrait generation papers, datasets and code.
orgs.description_zh: GitHub 上的说话人像与音频驱动人像生成论文、数据集与代码精选清单。

orgs.name: C2PA (Content Credentials)
orgs.description: The Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity, which maintains the open Content Credentials standard that several video and image generators attach to their output to mark it as AI-made.
orgs.description_zh: 内容来源与真实性联盟（C2PA），维护开放的“内容凭证”（Content Credentials）标准；多家视频与图像生成服务会在输出中附加该凭证，标明内容由 AI 生成。

orgs.name: Artificial Analysis Video Arena
orgs.description: Blind pairwise human-preference arena with Elo rankings for text-to-video and image-to-video models, with and without audio, alongside price and speed data.
orgs.description_zh: 盲测两两比较的人类偏好竞技场，为文生视频与图生视频模型（含声音与不含声音）给出 Elo 排名，并附价格与速度数据。

orgs.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena
orgs.description: Blind human-preference arena ranking text-to-speech models and voices, with price and latency comparisons.
orgs.description_zh: 盲测人类偏好竞技场，对文本转语音模型与声音进行排名，并比较价格与延迟。

orgs.name: VBench Leaderboard
orgs.description: Leaderboard for VBench, which scores video generators on 16 dimensions such as subject consistency, motion smoothness and physical plausibility.
orgs.description_zh: VBench 排行榜，从主体一致性、运动平滑度、物理合理性等 16 个维度为视频生成模型打分。

orgs.name: WorldScore
orgs.description: Unified benchmark and leaderboard for world generation from Stanford that compares 3D scene generators, 4D generators and video models on controllability, quality and dynamics.
orgs.description_zh: 斯坦福推出的世界生成统一评测基准与排行榜，从可控性、质量与动态性比较三维场景生成、四维生成与视频模型。

orgs.name: 3D Arena
orgs.description: Hugging Face arena where people vote between pairs of generated 3D models to rank image-to-3D generators.
orgs.description_zh: Hugging Face 上的竞技场，用户在成对的生成三维模型之间投票，为图生三维模型排名。

orgs.name: Arena (formerly LMArena)
orgs.description: The crowd-voted model ranking site that grew out of Chatbot Arena and LMArena; besides text it ranks text-to-video, image-to-video and image models.
orgs.description_zh: 从 Chatbot Arena 与 LMArena 发展而来的众包投票模型排名网站；除文本模型外，也对文生视频、图生视频与图像模型排名。

orgs.name: TTS Arena
orgs.description: Community Hugging Face arena where listeners vote between text-to-speech outputs, covering both open and commercial voices.
orgs.description_zh: Hugging Face 社区竞技场，听众在两段文本转语音输出之间投票，覆盖开源与商业声音。
